settings.name: Grafana URL
settings.description: The base URL of your Grafana instance (e.g., https://grafana.example.com). Optional: if left empty, call the set_grafana_url tool at runtime to configure it (and change it later) without restarting the server.

settings.name: Service Account Token
settings.description: Your Grafana Service Account Token (glsa_...). Optional; can also be supplied at runtime via the set_grafana_url tool's token argument.

settings.name: Organization ID
settings.description: The Grafana Organization ID to use
